question: The ratio between the height and radius of the base of a cylinder is 7 ∶ 5. If its volume is 14836.5 cm³, then find its total surface area (take π = 3.14).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **height (h)** to **radius (r)** = 7 : 5. Let h = 7x and r = 5x.

Volume = πr²h ⇒ 3.14 × (5x)² × (7x) = 14836.5

549.5x³ = 14836.5 ⇒ x³ = 27 ⇒ x = 3. So, **r = 15 cm** and **h = 21 cm**.

Total Surface Area = 2πr(h + r) = 2 × 3.14 × 15 × (21 + 15) = 94.2 × 36 = 3391.2 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 3391.2 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio **h : r** = 7 : 5, **Volume** = 14836.5 cm³, **π** = 3.14.

**Formula Used:** Volume of cylinder = πr²h; Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd94ea266f2f3e440847bf57a24914ae780c742c2506d2813ed06c6d8a989540.png] 

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × (5x)² × 7x = 14836.5

⇒ 3.14 × 25x² × 7x = 14836.5

⇒ 549.5x³ = 14836.5

⇒ x³ = 14836.5 ÷ 549.5 = 27

⇒ x = √³27 = 3

⇒ **Radius (r)** = 5 × 3 = 15 cm; **Height (h)** = 7 × 3 = 21 cm

⇒ **TSA** = 2 × 3.14 × 15 × (15 + 21)

⇒ **TSA** = 94.2 × 36 = 3391.2 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 3391.2 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The lateral area of a cylinder excluding its bases is given by CSA = 2πrh.

Volume of a Cylinder

The capacity or space occupied is Volume = Area of base × height = πr²h.

Total Surface Area Relationship

TSA is the sum of the curved surface area and the area of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr².</p
